explanation: The shared understanding and harmony that Christians should strive for to preserve the unity of the faith.
The quality of enduring difficulties or others' faults without becoming angry, which Paul encourages within the community of believers.
The deepest and most selfless form of care that binds everything together in perfect harmony.
Completely honest and devoted to truth, the opposite of the lie that must be put away.
The concept of the new creation in Christ, created according to God's will for righteousness and holiness.
The former way of life characterized by sin and corruption that must be put off.
The mark indicating that a believer belongs to God, given by the Holy Spirit as a guarantee of the future inheritance.
